events.event_name: Love, Kelly × Crocs NYFW Runway Show
events.what_it_is: Love, Kelly's Season 4 New York Fashion Week runway show in collaboration with Crocs, featuring one-of-one collection pieces, Crocs footwear and the release of the first song from the Love, Kelly album.
events.what_is_free: The current listing presents RSVP as the access path and does not advertise a paid ticket price. No merchandise or giveaway is promised.
events.caveats: RSVP is required, but acceptance is not automatic: the event copy says to RSVP for the chance to secure your name on the list. Treat this as approval-required access and do not assume submission confirms admission.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 8:00–8:30 PM at 15 W 36th Street. Use the Eventim RSVP page and wait for confirmation before treating attendance as confirmed.

events.address: Revelie Luncheonette, 179 Prince St, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A two-hour Maison Madison launch pop-up for the brand's new mug collection at Revelie Luncheonette.
events.what_is_free: Entry to browse the pop-up is listed as free and open to the public. The mugs and other merchandise are retail products; no free product is promised.
events.caveats: Current listings agree on the September 12 date, 11 AM–1 PM hours and 179 Prince Street location and describe the event as free/open to the public. The brand's current site confirms the mug launch but does not itself publish the pop-up logistics.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 11 AM–1 PM at Revelie Luncheonette, 179 Prince Street. No RSVP or host-approval requirement is published in the verified listings.
